title: Floor decal route
central_assumption: The supplier claim about twelve-point text at ten metres will hold for the route decals.
proposal: Put twelve-point route decals at the junctions, as proposed by the supplier.
risks: The pilot contradicts the supplier claim: four of six volunteers had to move closer.
rough_effort: One layout study and one supervised trial.
falsifying_test: Reject the proposed twelve-point size because the pilot already contradicts the universal claim; reconsider floor placement only after a new readability and safe-passage trial.
